metadata.methodology: Static source-code analysis of component .ts files. Each finding represents a verified behavior observed from reading component implementation. No browser runtime required — findings are grounded in code paths, not assumptions.

findings.scenario: variant="invalid-variant" (string outside union type)
findings.behavior: Lit assigns the invalid string to the property without runtime validation. Component renders without matching CSS variant selector, falling back to default primary styles. No error thrown, no console warning in production.
findings.remediation: Add a property setter that calls devWarn() when variant value is not in the allowed union. Clamp to default variant.

findings.scenario: loading=true and disabled=true simultaneously
findings.behavior: Both attributes are applied and aria-busy is set. Component renders correctly with both states. No conflict detected.
findings.remediation: No action required. Existing behavior is correct.

findings.scenario: value=null passed programmatically
findings.behavior: Lit converts null to empty string via @property({ type: String }). Native input value becomes empty string. No crash. Silent null-to-empty coercion without developer warning.
findings.remediation: Document null-coercion behavior in JSDoc. Optionally fire devWarn when null is explicitly passed to make the coercion visible during development.

findings.scenario: type="number" with value="not-a-number"
findings.behavior: Native input element receives value="not-a-number". Browser renders empty input and sets validationMessage. Component does not guard against this mismatch. No error thrown.
findings.remediation: When type="number", validate that value is numeric. Call devWarn when a non-numeric string is set as value for number type input.

findings.scenario: mode="invalid-value" (string outside single|multi)
findings.behavior: Invalid mode string is reflected to attribute. _enforceSingleMode() check (mode !== "single") passes, so multi-expand behavior activates unintentionally. No devWarn fires.
findings.remediation: Add property setter with devWarn() for invalid mode values. Clamp to "single" as safe default.

findings.scenario: value=NaN passed programmatically
findings.behavior: NaN propagates through _percentage calculation. Math.max(0, Math.min(1, NaN/100)) returns NaN. CSS custom property --_value-ratio is set to "NaN". Progress bar renders at 0% width (CSS treats NaN as invalid, clamps to 0). No crash but incorrect visual state.
findings.remediation: Guard _percentage calculation: if (isNaN(this.value)) { devWarn(...); return 0; }. Add explicit NaN check before setting CSS custom property.

findings.scenario: value=Infinity passed programmatically
findings.behavior: Infinity propagates to Math.min(Infinity, max). Result is max. Progress bar renders at 100% without error. Defensively correct behavior but unguarded.
findings.remediation: Add devWarn for Infinity values to surface developer errors. Current behavior (clamping to max) is acceptable but invisible.

findings.scenario: value outside 0-100 range (e.g., -50 or 150)
findings.behavior: devWarn fires in development. Value is clamped to valid range. Correct defensive pattern with developer visibility.
findings.remediation: No action required. devWarn + clamping pattern is correct.

findings.scenario: value=NaN or value=undefined programmatically
findings.behavior: Lit coerces undefined to "" for string properties. NaN passed as number converts to NaN string in attribute. Native input displays "NaN" as text. Form validity is affected. No component crash but misleading user display.
findings.remediation: Sanitize value in setter: if (isNaN(Number(value))) reset to empty or previous valid value and call devWarn().

findings.scenario: min > max configuration
findings.behavior: Native range input receives invalid min/max. Browser clamps range to 0-100 default or exhibits undefined behavior. No devWarn fires from component. Layout renders but thumb position is indeterminate.
findings.remediation: Validate min < max in updated() lifecycle. Fire devWarn when min >= max. Swap values or clamp to safe defaults.

findings.scenario: src="broken-url" with no fallback
findings.behavior: devWarn fires when both src and initials are absent. When src is present but broken, image load error event is handled. Falls back to initials if available, then to icon fallback. devWarn pattern is implemented.
findings.remediation: No action required. Error handling with fallback hierarchy is correct.

findings.scenario: activeTab set to out-of-bounds index
findings.behavior: devWarn fires in development when activeTab index has no corresponding hx-tab element. No crash. Tab selection silently fails, active state unchanged.
findings.remediation: devWarn pattern is correct. No additional action required.

findings.scenario: value set to non-existent option value
findings.behavior: devWarn fires: "Value [x] does not match any option". Select displays placeholder or blank. No crash. Developer is warned.
findings.remediation: devWarn pattern is correct. No additional action required.

findings.scenario: orientation="invalid" (string outside horizontal|vertical)
findings.behavior: devWarn fires with message "Invalid orientation [x], defaulting to horizontal." Property setter explicitly guards with devWarn.
findings.remediation: devWarn pattern is correct. No additional action required.

findings.scenario: Missing aria-label and no visible text label
findings.behavior: devWarn fires: "hx-icon-button requires an accessible label." No crash. Button renders without accessible name, violating WCAG 4.1.2.
findings.remediation: devWarn is present but warning is dev-only. In production, the button silently lacks an accessible name. Consider adding a data-attribute or runtime validation that persists in production builds for critical a11y issues.

findings.scenario: Rendered with no hx-accordion-item children
findings.behavior: Renders empty container with correct CSS parts. No crash. querySelectorAll returns empty NodeList. _enforceSingleMode() iterates over nothing safely.
findings.remediation: No action required. Empty accordion is valid.

findings.scenario: Rendered with no trigger slot content
findings.behavior: Summary trigger element renders with empty content. Keyboard navigation still works. Visually shows empty clickable area. Accessible name is empty string — violates WCAG 4.1.2. No devWarn fires.
findings.remediation: Add slotchange handler for trigger slot. Fire devWarn when trigger slot is empty: "hx-accordion-item trigger slot is empty — provide a visible label for keyboard and screen reader users."

findings.scenario: Rendered with no footer slot
findings.behavior: Footer region hides itself when _hasFooterSlot is false. slotchange handler on footer slot sets _hasFooterSlot state. Graceful degradation. No crash.
findings.remediation: No action required. Footer slot handling is correct.

findings.scenario: Rendered with no header slot and no heading attribute
findings.behavior: aria-labelledby points to _headingId which renders empty heading element. Dialog lacks accessible name. No devWarn fires for missing heading in production.
findings.remediation: Add warning when both heading attribute is empty and header slot is unpopulated. Unlabeled dialogs violate WCAG 4.1.2.

findings.scenario: hx-tab count does not match hx-tab-panel count
findings.behavior: devWarn fires for both surplus tabs and surplus panels. MutationObserver detects DOM changes and re-validates. Correct developer guidance.
findings.remediation: No action required. devWarn pattern for slot mismatch is correct.

findings.scenario: Rendered with no option children
findings.behavior: Renders empty dropdown list. User opens dropdown and sees blank list. No crash. No devWarn for empty option set.
findings.remediation: Fire devWarn when no option elements are found after slotchange: "hx-select has no options — add hx-option or <option> elements as children."

findings.scenario: Rendered with no slot content (empty label)
findings.behavior: Button renders with zero-width label area. aria-label not set. Accessible name is empty string unless aria-label attribute provided externally. No crash.
findings.remediation: Add slotchange handler. Fire devWarn when default slot is empty and no aria-label set: "hx-button has no label and no aria-label — button will have no accessible name."

findings.scenario: No label attribute and no label slot
findings.behavior: devWarn fires every render cycle: "No accessible label provided..." This is correct behavior but fires on every updated() call, which may spam console on frequent value updates.
findings.remediation: Gate devWarn to fire only once per component instance (use a private _warnedAboutLabel flag). Current implementation spams console on every render.

findings.scenario: Card rendered with no slot content
findings.behavior: devWarn fires when specific required slot conditions are not met. Empty card renders valid shell. No crash.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: open toggled 50x in <100ms via attribute mutation
findings.behavior: Each open change triggers _openDialog() or _closeDialog() via updated(). _addGlobalListeners()/_removeGlobalListeners() called alternately. No debounce. Rapid toggle risk: if toggled during body-scroll-lock sequence, lockBodyScroll()/unlockBodyScroll() could be called asymmetrically, leaving scroll permanently locked.
findings.remediation: Add guard flag _isTransitioning. Skip open/close operations if transition is in progress. Reset flag after transition animation completes.

findings.scenario: open toggled rapidly while animation is in progress
findings.behavior: clearTimeout(_animationTimeout) is called on each state change, correctly aborting the previous animation timeout. New timeout is set. State converges on final value. No memory leak or state corruption detected.
findings.remediation: No action required. Animation timeout management handles rapid toggling correctly.

findings.scenario: trigger hovered and un-hovered 20x in rapid succession
findings.behavior: Show timer (_showTimer) is cleared and reset on each mouse event. Only the final timer fires. Document listeners are added only on actual show. No listener accumulation. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required. Debounced show-timer pattern handles rapid hover correctly.

findings.scenario: show() called while auto-dismiss timer is running, then hide() immediately
findings.behavior: _clearTimer() is called in hide(). If show() is called again before the first dismiss fires, _startTimer() creates a new timer without clearing the old one if _timer was already null. Toast timer management correctly handles this.
findings.remediation: No action required. Timer management is correct.

findings.scenario: 10 expand/collapse calls on same item in <50ms
findings.behavior: hx-expand events bubble synchronously. _handleChildExpand runs synchronously. No async state involved. Final state equals last operation. No race condition. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required. Synchronous event handling prevents race conditions.

findings.scenario: open/close toggled 30x in rapid succession
findings.behavior: Document click listener is added/removed on each open/close. clearTimeout not used — no animation timeout in dropdown. Risk: if open state changes faster than microtask queue, addEventListener could be called multiple times before removeEventListener. Document listener accumulation possible.
findings.remediation: Track whether document click listener is currently attached with a boolean flag. Guard addEventListener to only add if not already added.

findings.scenario: activeTab property changed 20x rapidly via JavaScript
findings.behavior: Lit batches property updates within a microtask. Multiple rapid property sets result in a single render update with the final value. MutationObserver is not triggered by property changes, only DOM changes. No state corruption.
findings.remediation: No action required. Lit update batching handles rapid property changes correctly.

findings.scenario: Increment button held down — long-press timer start/stop rapidly
findings.behavior: _clearLongPress() is called on pointerup/pointercancel/pointerleave. _longPressTimer is cleared and nulled. Restart protected by null check. No timer accumulation.
findings.remediation: No action required. Long-press timer management is correct.

findings.scenario: Remove from DOM and re-insert while child items are expanded
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback removes hx-expand and keydown listeners. connectedCallback re-adds them. _enforceSingleMode() runs in firstUpdated() but NOT on reconnect. After re-insert, if multiple items were expanded before removal, _enforceSingleMode does not re-run.
findings.remediation: Call _enforceSingleMode() in connectedCallback (not just firstUpdated()) to enforce invariants on reconnection.

findings.scenario: Removed from DOM while open (modal=true)
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback calls _removeGlobalListeners() and unlockBodyScroll() if modal and open. Body scroll is properly restored. No dangling listeners.
findings.remediation: No action required. DOM removal cleanup is correct.

findings.scenario: Moved between two different parent containers via DOM reparenting
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback disconnects MutationObserver and sets _observer = null. connectedCallback creates new MutationObserver and begins observing new parent context. Correct lifecycle. Cache of tabs/panels is rebuilt via _updateInternalState().
findings.remediation: No action required. MutationObserver lifecycle is correct on reparenting.

findings.scenario: Component cloned via cloneNode(true) then appended elsewhere
findings.behavior: cloneNode copies attributes but does NOT copy Lit reactive state or event listeners. Cloned element is an uninitialized custom element. Lit will upgrade it when appended to a live document. No crash but initial state may not match source element state.
findings.remediation: Document that hx-* components should not be cloned via cloneNode. State must be re-set after cloning. This is expected custom element behavior.

findings.scenario: Removed from DOM while popover is visible
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback clears _showTimer, removes document click listener, and removes document keydown listeners. No dangling document listeners. The floating-ui positioning calculation references removed element — but since popover is removed, no further positioning runs.
findings.remediation: No action required. Cleanup on disconnect is thorough.

findings.scenario: Removed from DOM while dropdown is open
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback removes document click listener. Open state persists in memory but dropdown is no longer rendered. On reconnect, if open=true in state, dropdown re-opens visually. Document click listener is only re-added on actual user interaction opening the dropdown.
findings.remediation: Set open=false in disconnectedCallback to ensure closed state on reconnect. Avoids surprising auto-reopening behavior.

findings.scenario: Removed from DOM while auto-dismiss timer is active
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback calls _clearTimer(), which clears the setTimeout and nulls _timer. No timer fires after removal. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required. Timer cleanup on disconnect is correct.

findings.scenario: Removed from DOM while long-press is in progress
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback calls _clearLongPress() which clears the setTimeout. Long-press acceleration stops. No dangling timer. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Used outside hx-accordion container
findings.behavior: Renders and functions as a standalone collapsible section. hx-expand events bubble but no parent accordion handles them — no crash. Single-expand mode is not enforced since no parent coordinates it. No devWarn fires to alert the developer.
findings.remediation: Add connectedCallback check: if (this.closest("hx-accordion") === null) { devWarn("hx-accordion-item", "Used outside hx-accordion. Single-expand coordination will not function."); }

findings.scenario: Used outside hx-tabs container
findings.behavior: hx-tab renders standalone button. hx-tab-select event bubbles but no hx-tabs parent handles it. Tab state does not update. No devWarn fires.
findings.remediation: Add devWarn in connectedCallback: "hx-tab must be a direct child of hx-tabs to function correctly."

findings.scenario: Used outside hx-tabs container
findings.behavior: hx-tab-panel renders content unconditionally since no hx-tabs parent manages visibility. Panel is always visible. No crash. No devWarn.
findings.remediation: Document that hx-tab-panel requires hx-tabs parent context. Add devWarn in connectedCallback.

findings.scenario: hx-menu-item used outside hx-menu
findings.behavior: hx-menu-item fires devWarn in connectedCallback when not inside hx-menu. Developer is alerted.
findings.remediation: No action required. devWarn pattern is correct.

findings.scenario: Action item used outside action bar
findings.behavior: devWarn fires for invalid configuration patterns. Developer guidance is present.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Form field components used outside hx-form
findings.behavior: hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox use ElementInternals for form association. They work with any native <form> ancestor, not just hx-form. Using them outside a form element is valid per HTML specification. No crash.
findings.remediation: No action required. ElementInternals-based form association works with any form ancestor.

findings.scenario: hx-checkbox used outside hx-checkbox-group
findings.behavior: hx-checkbox functions as a standalone form-associated checkbox. hx-checkbox-group only provides group ARIA context. Standalone use is valid. No devWarn needed.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: hx-dropdown used with non-dropdown-item children
findings.behavior: Dropdown renders slotted content without validation. Non-dropdown-item children are included in keyboard navigation via querySelectorAll selector. Potential for keyboard navigation to target unexpected elements.
findings.remediation: Add devWarn when slotted children are not hx-dropdown-item elements: "hx-dropdown expects hx-dropdown-item children for keyboard navigation."

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: hx-expand and keydown listener cleanup
findings.behavior: connectedCallback adds 2 event listeners (hx-expand, keydown). disconnectedCallback removes both. No accumulation possible since listeners are removed before re-added on each cycle.
findings.remediation: No action required. Listener management is correct.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x while modal open: body scroll and listener cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback calls _removeGlobalListeners() (removes 3 dialog-internal listeners) and unlockBodyScroll(). lockBodyScroll/unlockBodyScroll are symmetric. No scroll lock accumulation detected.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: MutationObserver cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback: _observer?.disconnect() and _observer = null. connectedCallback: new MutationObserver() created fresh. No observer accumulation. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required. MutationObserver lifecycle is correct.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: showTimer and document listener cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback: clearTimeout(_showTimer) and null. document.removeEventListener for click and keydown. All listeners are registered with arrow function references stored on the instance. Removal uses same references. No accumulation.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: document outside-click listener cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback removes document click listener with { capture: true }. However, the open state is not reset on disconnect. If open=true when removed, document listener is removed correctly. Risk: if disconnect happens between addEventListener and removeEventListener timing (open event not yet fired), listener may not be present to remove, which is safe (no-op).
findings.remediation: No action required. Event listener cleanup is correct.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: animation timeout and body scroll cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback: clearTimeout(_animationTimeout), _restoreBodyScroll(), _removeListeners(). All resources cleaned up. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: auto-dismiss timer cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback calls _clearTimer() which clears setTimeout and nulls _timer. No timer fires post-removal. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: long-press timer cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback calls _clearLongPress() which clears setTimeout. No timer leak. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: document click listener cleanup
findings.behavior: disconnectedCallback removes document click listener. However open state is preserved across disconnect/reconnect. If open=true on reconnect, dropdown is visible but document listener is not re-added until user interaction. Clicking outside will NOT close the dropdown until user interacts.
findings.remediation: Set open=false in disconnectedCallback to ensure clean state on reconnect. Avoids confusing open-but-unmanaged dropdown state.

findings.scenario: Attach/detach 100x: document click listener cleanup
findings.behavior: Same pattern as hx-select: disconnectedCallback removes document click listener. Open state not reset. Same risk as hx-select.
findings.remediation: Set open=false in disconnectedCallback. Document this as a known behavior in AUDIT.md.

findings.scenario: open=true and heading="Title" set in same synchronous block
findings.behavior: Lit 3.x batches property changes within a single microtask. Both property changes are queued before requestUpdate fires. updated() receives changedProperties with both keys. _openDialog() is called once with heading already set. No flash of incorrectly-labeled dialog.
findings.remediation: No action required. Lit update batching handles concurrent property sets correctly.

findings.scenario: value, disabled, error set simultaneously
findings.behavior: Lit batches all three property changes. updated() processes all in one cycle. internals.setValidity() is called once with final state. No intermediate invalid states rendered.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: mode="multi" and items expanded in same microtask
findings.behavior: Lit batches mode change and firstUpdated has already run. On mode change via property, Lit does not re-call firstUpdated. _enforceSingleMode() is only called from firstUpdated, not from updated(). If mode changes from single to multi after init, previously collapsed items remain collapsed (correct). If mode changes from multi to single, extra open items are NOT collapsed.
findings.remediation: Call _enforceSingleMode() from updated() when mode property changes to "single". Currently only called from firstUpdated().

findings.scenario: value and disabled set simultaneously
findings.behavior: Lit batches both. internals.setValidity() reflects combined state correctly. No intermediate renders.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Multiple tabs added to DOM in single synchronous block
findings.behavior: MutationObserver childList mutation is debounced by browser — a single microtask batch of childList mutations fires one MutationObserver callback. _updateInternalState() is called once. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required. MutationObserver batches DOM changes correctly.

findings.scenario: value, min, max set simultaneously
findings.behavior: Lit batches all three. updated() checks changedProperties.has() for each. Validity is calculated with all final values. No intermediate invalid state.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: value changed rapidly (100 updates in 16ms via rAF loop)
findings.behavior: Lit batches updates: only the last value in each microtask batch triggers a render. CSS custom property is set in updated(), which runs after each coalesced render. High-frequency updates reduce to render-rate updates. No memory leak. No accumulation.
findings.remediation: No action required. Lit reactive update system handles high-frequency property updates.

findings.scenario: hx-tab and hx-tab-panel added after initial render via appendChild
findings.behavior: MutationObserver watches for childList changes and calls _updateInternalState() on mutation. Late-added tabs and panels are detected and integrated into tab navigation. slotchange is not used — DOM observation handles late content correctly.
findings.remediation: No action required. MutationObserver handles late slot projection correctly.

findings.scenario: Footer slot content added after dialog is already mounted
findings.behavior: slotchange event on footer slot updates _hasFooterSlot state. Footer region becomes visible reactively. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required. slotchange handler correctly updates footer visibility.

findings.scenario: hx-accordion-item added to hx-accordion after initial render
findings.behavior: No MutationObserver in hx-accordion. New items are included in querySelectorAll when hx-expand events bubble from them. Late-added items participate in event coordination. However, _enforceSingleMode() is not re-run on new item addition — if new item is pre-expanded and another item is already expanded, single-expand constraint is violated.
findings.remediation: Add MutationObserver in hx-accordion to watch for new hx-accordion-item children. Call _enforceSingleMode() when new items are detected.

findings.scenario: Option elements added after select is mounted
findings.behavior: slotchange handler refreshes internal option list. New options are included in keyboard navigation and value matching. Late projection is supported.
findings.remediation: No action required. slotchange handles late option projection correctly.

findings.scenario: Label slot content added after initial render (no label attribute)
findings.behavior: _onLabelSlotChange handler sets _hasLabelSlotContent state. devWarn for missing label stops firing once slot has content. Correct reactive behavior.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Slot content added to named slots after initial render
findings.behavior: slotchange handlers update internal state for header/footer/media slot presence. Card layout reflows correctly. Correct.
findings.remediation: No action required.

findings.scenario: Slot content added after initial render (empty then populated)
findings.behavior: Default slot in Shadow DOM: slotchange event fires when assigned nodes change. hx-button does not listen to slotchange — it renders the slot unconditionally. New content appears correctly without any handler needed.
findings.remediation: No action required. Slot content appears automatically without explicit slotchange handler.

findings.scenario: Dropdown items added after initial render
findings.behavior: hx-dropdown does not use MutationObserver or slotchange. Internal item list is built on open via querySelectorAll. Late-added items are included on next open. Correct, since list is rebuilt dynamically on each open.
findings.remediation: No action required.

recommendations.title: Add NaN/Infinity guards to numeric components
recommendations.action: Add isNaN() and isFinite() checks in property setters or updated(). Call devWarn() with diagnostic message. Clamp to safe defaults.
recommendations.rationale: Healthcare applications display critical metrics (vitals, dosages, lab values). NaN rendering as 0% or displaying "NaN" text is a patient safety concern.

recommendations.title: Reset open=false in disconnectedCallback for overlay components
recommendations.action: Add this.open = false in disconnectedCallback for any component that manages open/closed dropdown state.
recommendations.rationale: Reconnected components with stale open state create confusing UX. Dropdown is visible but unmanaged — outside clicks will not close it.

recommendations.title: Call _enforceSingleMode() from updated() in hx-accordion
recommendations.action: In updated(), check changedProperties.has("mode") and call _enforceSingleMode() when mode changes to "single". Also call _enforceSingleMode() in connectedCallback.
recommendations.rationale: Dynamic mode switching leaves stale expanded state. Reconnect does not restore invariants.

recommendations.title: Add devWarn for orphaned child components
recommendations.action: In connectedCallback, check closest("hx-accordion") / closest("hx-tabs") and fire devWarn if absent.
recommendations.rationale: Orphaned child components silently lose parent coordination. Developer warning surfaces the misconfiguration in dev/test environments.

recommendations.title: Fix rapid-toggle document listener accumulation in hx-dropdown
recommendations.action: Add private _documentListenerAttached = false flag. Guard addEventListener/removeEventListener with this flag.
recommendations.rationale: Rapid open/close toggling may cause document click listener to accumulate, breaking outside-click dismissal.

recommendations.title: Deduplicate devWarn spam in hx-progress-bar
recommendations.action: Add private _warnedAboutLabel = false. Set to true after first devWarn fires. Only fire once per instance.
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation spams the console on every render when label is missing. One warning per instance is sufficient.
